required_outcomes: Recognises that 'the problem I reported' is ambiguous: the closing message covered both the oven and the fence, and the tenant does not say which.
Asks the tenant which issue is still happening and what exactly she is seeing now, before booking anyone.
Does not dispatch a contractor or reopen with a contractor instruction until the issue is identified.
acceptable_alternatives: Provisionally reopening the oven request (the thread it arrived on) while asking which issue she means, provided no contractor is sent until she answers.
Asking whether it is the oven or the fence and offering a call at a time that suits her.
positive_behaviours: Mentions that the fence was never on a job of its own, so it can be raised properly if that is what she means.
Sets a follow-up to chase the tenant if she does not reply.
red_flags: Assuming it is the oven and sending Lantern Works back without asking.
Escalating an unclear but routine follow-up to a human.
prohibited_actions: Booking a contractor visit before the issue is identified.
critical_failures: Ignoring the email or replying only that the request is closed.
